lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Refresh simple present-tense introductions and polite first exchanges.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Two colleagues meet at the office coffee area on a quiet morning.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Introducing yourself and asking basic personal questions.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik meet near the coffee machine, greet each other, say their names, and exchange a few simple details about where they live and work.

main_focus.name: present tense in simple main clauses
main_focus.description: Use short subject-verb statements for identity, home, and work details.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use simple present-tense main clauses naturally 6-8 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: personal pronouns: jag, du, han, hon

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use most active words if they fit naturally, with greetings and names clearly established.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker greets the other and starts a friendly introduction.
dialogue_shape.middle: They ask and answer basic questions about name, home, and work.
dialogue_shape.ending: They close politely and suggest continuing later or getting coffee.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat simple present-tense patterns enough for easy listening practice

focus: where one speaker lives or comes from
how the speakers politely start the conversation

sentence_focus: one sentence saying where someone lives
one question asking for a name
one sentence saying someone works here
one polite greeting or closing phrase
